ready.title: Create WebMCP tool generator script (flow-webmcp-generator.js)
ready.description: Create flow-webmcp-generator.js that generates WebMCP tool definitions from component analysis. Scans app-map for interactive components, generates navigator.modelContext tool schemas, outputs to .workflow/webmcp/tools.json. Supports React, Vue, Svelte component patterns.

ready.title: Rewrite wogi-debug-browser with WebMCP backend
ready.description: Rewrite wogi-debug-browser.md to use WebMCP tool calls instead of screenshots. Navigate via structured DOM tools, read page state via tool responses, interact with forms/buttons via tool calls. 89% token reduction vs screenshot approach. Fallback to screenshot if WebMCP unavailable.

ready.title: Rewrite wogi-test-browser with WebMCP test flows
ready.description: Rewrite wogi-test-browser.md to use WebMCP for test execution. Define test flows as WebMCP tool sequences. Assert page state via structured tool responses instead of screenshot comparison. Generate test reports with pass/fail per tool call.
